speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg. To determine the cause, have you noticed any weakness, numbness, or tingling in the affected leg?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on your description of sudden, sharp back pain radiating to the leg after gym exercise, this sounds like a disc herniation. Can you tell me if the pain worsens when you cough, sneeze, or lie down flat? REQUEST TEST: MRI Lumbar_Spine.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Lumbar_Spine Findings: Evidence of L5-S1 disc herniation impinging on the adjacent nerve root.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: L5-S1 Disc Herniation. The imaging confirms a herniation at the L5-S1 level impinging on the nerve root, which explains your symptoms of sudden-onset pain radiating from the lower back down the leg and foot following physical exertion.
